annotations.description: {{ printf "%.0f" $values.B.Value }} matching lines in the last 5 minutes. Cause: {{ $labels.reason }}. Host: {{ $labels.host }}. Compose project: {{ $labels.compose_project }}. Component: {{ $labels.component }}. Fires at 5+ matching lines with the condition held for 2 minutes. Camera worker errors can affect recording while Frigate stays running. Open the linked dashboard for original messages.

model.expr: sum by (host, container, compose_project, component, reason) (count_over_time({source="docker",container!~"grafana|loki",service!="loki",service_name!="loki"} | decolorize | line_format `{{ __line__ }}` |~ `(?i)\b(err(or)?|exception|failed|failure|fatal|panic)\b` !~ `(?i)(\b(level[=:]"?(info|debug|warn)|INFO|DEBUG|WRN)\b|without errors?|no errors?|Non-monotonic DTS|Timestamps are unset in a packet|The following ffmpeg logs include)` | regexp `(?:watchdog|ffmpeg)\.(?P<camera>[A-Za-z0-9_-]+)` | label_format component=`{{if .camera}}{{.camera}}{{else}}{{.container}}{{end}}`, reason=`{{if contains "No new valid recording segments" (__line__)}}Camera recording stalled for 120 seconds; FFmpeg restart requested{{else if contains "crashed unexpectedly" (__line__)}}Camera FFmpeg worker crashed; check stream and recording recovery{{else if contains "Connection timed out" (__line__)}}Upstream connection timed out{{else if contains "context canceled" (__line__)}}Request canceled during upstream authentication{{else if contains "Error opening input" (__line__)}}FFmpeg could not open the camera stream{{else if contains "Unable to read frames" (__line__)}}Camera frames unavailable{{else}}Application reported an error; inspect matching logs{{end}}` [5m]))

annotations.description: {{ printf "%.0f" $values.B.Value }} critical-pattern lines in the last 5 minutes. {{ $labels.reason }}. Host: {{ $labels.host }}. Project: {{ $labels.compose_project }}. Container: {{ $labels.container }}. Inspect logs and process health; a log pattern alone does not prove the container is down.

model.expr: sum by (host, container, compose_project, component, reason) (count_over_time({source="docker",container!~"grafana|loki",service!="loki",service_name!="loki"} | decolorize | line_format `{{ __line__ }}` |~ `(?i)\b(fatal|panic|segmentation fault|out of memory|oom[- ]kill(ed)?|crash[ -]?loop)\b` !~ `(?i)(\b(level[=:]"?(info|debug)|INFO|DEBUG)\b|without errors?|no errors?)` | label_format component=container, reason="Fatal, panic, memory exhaustion, or crash-loop log pattern" [5m]))
